missing.title: The application engine cannot be found
missing.text:
The file {{file}} is expected in the installation folder.
It was probably quarantined by the antivirus: add it to the exclusions, then retry.

versionMismatch.title: The update is incomplete
versionMismatch.text:
The application is at version {{ui}}, but its engine is at version {{sidecar}}.
Reinstall the application.

close.title: Quit the application?
close.extraction: An extraction is in progress: the copy will be cut short and a file may end up corrupted.
close.write: Files are being written: wait for it to finish before quitting.
close.rollback: A restore is in progress: wait for it to finish before quitting.

errors.malformed_command:
An internal error interrupted the operation.
Restart the application.
errors.unknown_error:
An unexpected error interrupted the operation.
If it happens again, the details are in the logs folder.
errors.playlist_error:
This playlist file could not be read.
Choose another one.
errors.unsupported_playlist_format: {{filename}} is neither a VLC media library nor a readable M3U8 playlist.
errors.vlc_schema_mismatch:
This VLC media library comes from a version the application cannot read.
Install the latest version of the application.
errors.playlist_not_found: No playlist named {{playlist_name}} in this media library.
errors.unreadable_dump: {{filename}} is not a readable VLC media library.
errors.playlist_name_required: Choose a playlist from this VLC media library.
errors.extraction_error:
The extraction failed before it started.
Try again.
errors.report_error: The extraction report could not be produced.
errors.report_write_failed: The tracks were extracted but the report could not be written: {{filename}}.
errors.source_folder_unreadable:
The source folder cannot be read: {{folder}}.
Check that it still exists.
errors.artwork_unavailable:
The artwork could not be downloaded.
Start the run again to retry.
errors.destination_folder_unwritable:
The destination folder cannot be created: {{folder}}.
Choose another one.
errors.sidecar_unavailable:
The application engine is not responding.
Restart the application.
errors.files_error: The audio files could not be read.
errors.tagging_folder_unreadable: The folder to re-tag cannot be found or read: {{folder}}.
errors.tags_unreadable: The tags of {{file}} could not be read.
errors.tags_write_failed: The tags of {{file}} could not be written.
errors.file_rename_failed: The file {{file}} could not be renamed.
errors.tag_dump_error:
Saving the original tags failed.
Restart the application and try again.
errors.tag_dump_write_failed:
The original tags could not be saved: no file was changed.
Free up disk space, then write again.
errors.tag_dump_unreadable:
The saved original tags are unreadable, or come from another version of the application.
These files can no longer be restored: start a new run to retag them.
errors.tagging_report_unreadable:
This run report is unreadable, or comes from a newer version of the application.
Update the application, then open it again.
errors.run_plan_unreadable:
The interrupted run cannot be resumed: it was saved by another version of the application, or its record is unreadable.
Start over to run it again.
errors.run_not_found:
This run no longer exists: its record or its report was deleted.
Start a new run on the folder.
errors.scraper_error:
The search failed.
Try again later.
errors.api_key_rejected:
The API key was rejected.
Check it in the settings.
errors.source_unavailable:
{{source}} is not responding.
Try again later.
errors.track_not_found:
This link leads to no track on {{source}}.
Check the link.
errors.unsupported_url:
This link is not a Beatport, Bandcamp or SoundCloud track.
Copy the link of the track page.
errors.api_contract_error:
The search received an unexpected response.
If the problem comes back, the details are in the logs folder.
errors.api_key_error:
The API key could not be saved.
Try again.
errors.api_key_not_stored:
The key could not be saved on this computer.
Try again.
errors.api_key_malformed:
This key contains a space or a character that is not accepted.
Paste it again with nothing around it.
errors.api_key_missing:
No API key saved.
Add one in the settings.
errors.keyring_unavailable:
Windows Credential Manager is unavailable.
Restart the application.
errors.write_not_open: This run cannot be written now.
errors.run_not_written:
The run on screen is waiting for its tags to be written.
Finish writing before clearing the cache.
errors.feedback_export_write_failed:
The run export could not be written to the application folder.
Check the free disk space, then send the report again.
errors.run_committed: Writing this run is confirmed: its tracks can no longer be arbitrated or recovered.
errors.rollback_unavailable: Nothing to restore: these files already have their original tags back, or their backup has expired.

phase_busy.extraction:
An extraction is in progress.
Wait for it to finish.
phase_busy.tagging:
A search is in progress.
Wait for it to finish.
phase_busy.write:
Writing is in progress.
Wait for it to finish.
phase_busy.rollback:
A restore is in progress.
Wait for it to finish.

errors.arbitration_error:
This decision could not be taken into account.
Try again.
errors.arbitration_not_pending:
This track is no longer awaiting a decision.
Move on to the next one.
errors.arbitration_candidate_unknown:
Candidate unavailable.
Choose another one from the list shown.
errors.arbitration_busy:
A decision is already in progress for this track.
Please wait a moment.
errors.url_recovery_error:
The link could not be resolved.
Try again.
errors.url_recovery_not_eligible:
This track already has a match and no longer takes a link.
Move on to the next track.
errors.url_recovery_busy:
A link is already being resolved for this track.
Please wait a moment.
errors.url_recovery_not_open: Links can be pasted once the search has finished.

idle.heading: No extraction yet
idle.description: Choose the source, the destination and the playlist, then start the extraction.

blocked.tagging: Wait for the current run to finish on the Tagging tab.

summary.expandDisabled: Choices are frozen during the extraction.

empty.heading: Empty playlist
empty.description: This playlist has no track to extract.

criterion.path_order: Same size, first path in alphabetical order

commit.message:
Folder: {{folder}}

Files to rewrite and rename to “Artist - Title”: {{count}}
commit.awaiting:
Still awaiting arbitration: {{count}}
They will not be written and can no longer be arbitrated.
commit.backup: The original tags are backed up before writing: you can restore the whole run or a single track.

retry.message:
Failed files to rewrite: {{count}}
Only these files are retried, with no new search or arbitration.

rollback.message:
Files to restore: {{count}}

They get back their original name and tags.
Artwork set by the write stays in place.
Comments removed by the write are not recovered.
rollback.blocked: A write or a restore is in progress.

write.phase: Writing tags and artwork, then renaming
write.failed:
Files that failed to write: {{count}}
Hover over each state to see why it failed: fix it, then retry writing.

blocked.running: Wait for the current run to finish.
blocked.recovering: Wait for the current recovery to answer.
blocked.api_key: Save your API key in the settings first.
blocked.folder: Choose the folder to re-tag first.
blocked.extracting: Wait for the current extraction on the Playlist tab to finish.
blocked.sidecar: The application engine is not ready yet.
blocked.writing: Wait for the current write to finish.
blocked.arbitrating: Wait for the current arbitration to answer.
blocked.restoring: Wait for the restore in progress to finish.

empty.heading: No run yet
empty.description: Choose the folder to re-tag, then start the run.
empty.ready: Start the run to look up this folder's tracks on Beatport or Bandcamp.

reason.empty_query:
Neither the tags nor the file name give an artist or a title.
Rename the file as "Artist - Title".
reason.no_result: No result on Beatport or Bandcamp.
reason.source_unavailable:
Beatport and Bandcamp did not respond.
Run it again later.

empty.heading: No audio file in this folder
empty.description: Choose a folder holding MP3, WAV, AIFF or FLAC files.

detail.unreadable: This file's tags could not be read.

recovery.help: Optional step: paste the link of a Beatport, Bandcamp or SoundCloud track.
recovery.unavailable: Available once the search is finished.

empty.heading: No unresolved track
empty.description: Every track in the run found a source.

empty.heading: No track matches
empty.description: Change the filter or clear the search.

none.heading: No run to summarize
none.description: Start a run from the Tagging tab.

past.heading: This run cannot be shown
past.description: Reopen a run from the Settings tab.

reason.name_taken:
Another file already has its original name.
Rename or move that file, then restore again.

reason.permission_denied: Access to the file was denied.
reason.path_too_long: The file path is too long.
reason.file_locked: The file is open in another program.
reason.file_missing: The file was moved, renamed or deleted.
reason.write_failed: The file could not be processed.

fix.path_too_long: Move the folder to the drive root or shorten the folder names, then {{retry}}.

arbitration.switched: The Beatport candidates were refused: here is the Bandcamp list.
arbitration.beatportUnavailable: Beatport is not responding: here are the Bandcamp candidates.
arbitration.help: Switch arbitration with the arrows, select with a click, confirm with Enter.

key.label: API key
key.hint: Stored securely on this computer. It is never shown again: to change it, enter a new one.

floor.label: Floor
floor.hint:
Applied separately to the artist score and the title score.
Below it, the candidate is discarded.

ceiling.label: High threshold
ceiling.hint:
Applied to the average of both.
Above it, automatic validation.
In between, uncertain match: to arbitrate.

reset.blocked: The thresholds are already the default ones.

language.label: Language
language.hint:
Applies immediately.
On first launch, the application follows the system language.

sound.label: Completion sound
sound.hint: A beep when an extraction, a search, a write or a restore ends.

admin.title: Administration
admin.starting:
The application engine is starting.
Wait a moment.

cache.label: Cache
cache.hint:
API responses and artwork already downloaded.
Clearing it touches no music file: the next runs download them again.

blocked.busy:
An operation is in progress.
Wait for it to finish.

logs.label: Logs
logs.hint: To report a problem, attach the selected file to your message.
logs.unavailable:
The log file cannot be found.
Restart the application to create it again.

pastRuns.label: Past runs
pastRuns.hint: Reopens the summary of a run already written, read-only.

rollback.label: Restore
rollback.hint: Restores the original name and tags of the files from the last written run.
rollback.none: No run to restore: no recent tag backup.
rollback.loading: Looking for the last written run…

resume.title: Resume the interrupted run?
resume.safe: No file was touched since: resuming is safe.
resume.folderMissing:
This folder cannot be found or no longer holds any audio file.
Plug the drive back in or put the files back, then restart the application.

unreadable.version:
This run was saved by another version of the application (version {{found}}, expected {{expected}}).
It cannot be resumed: start over.
unreadable.corrupted:
The file of this run is damaged.
It cannot be resumed: start over.
